card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A digit that starts or sits inside a number whose remaining digits come next, such as the 1 in 100 or the 5 in 57%. Mostly in doses, percentages, and lab or strain codes.

modes.label: Digit inside dose
modes.description: The leading digit of a dose or range value, with more digits following.
modes.example: the recommended dosage is <<1>>00 to 125 mg

modes.label: Digit inside percentage
modes.description: A digit in a percentage whose last digit or percent sign comes next.

modes.label: Digit in codes
modes.description: A digit within strain names, product names or IP addresses.

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing a number with more digits and away from tokens like 1 or other number words.
card.plain: It fires on the opening digit of a number that is still being written out, like the 1 in 100 mg.
